Callout.Name: Respiratory Distress
Callout.Message: Person struggling to breathe, inhaler empty.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, sitting up, speaking in short sentences.

Script.Line: It came on in the night. I have been sat up since four.
The blue inhaler is finished and the other one makes my heart race.
If I lean forward it is easier. Let me lean forward.

Callout.Patient: I can breathe again. I really could not get it in.

Lines.Approach: She is sitting up and cannot finish a sentence. Inhaler is empty.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
